endpoint: existing explicit project/location registry recipe, /api once; no generation fallback/redirect; v2 exact refs pin URL/ID, changed override endpoint_unavailable before target I/O
auth: explicit project IAM; credential-source management auth distinct from protected legacy token path input; no automatic S3/OCI auth substitution

parameters.description: Unique identifier of the authentication token.
parameters.name: token

request.mapping: nil omitted; false/empty preserved; source-required request fields and finite query enums validated before credentials/HTTP; TTL only12h/1y; no inserted defaults; opaque path components escaped once (dot-only safe); v1 credential input never persisted in refs/receipts. v2 ID refs require exact scope/service/generation/kind/no-parent

400.description: Bad request. Fix the request and try again.

500.description: Server is not responding. Please try again later.

response.mapping: Legacy metadata only; source expireAt/expireIn exact Integer, no copy of caller credential inserted into response
response.numbers: v1 timestamp seconds and remaining duration remain exact Integer, no lossy conversion or invented epoch/offset
response.timestamps: v2 RFC3339 explicit offset required, time.Time normalized UTC; no invented timezone

errors.shared: 401 IAM refresh;403 permission_denied;404 not_found;409 conflict;429 rate_limited;400 and other unmapped status provider_error. No source machine codes or provider-text parsing invented
errors.mutation: only documented4xx rejection plus shared auth statuses conclusively rejected; unconfirmed rejection/transport/5xx unknown_outcome,no replay. Malformed accepted body protocol_error with Receipt and trustworthy original/provider ID retained

retry: bounded safe reads only; mutations never replay

wait.meaning: exact v2 delete absence only; no credential validity/rotation/refresh/revocation readiness proof

recovery.legacy: no secret in plain ResourceRef; unknown v1 recovery unavailable. Explicit protected-input Get observational only
recovery.v2: root Resource/Resume exact ID Get; unknown remains indeterminate regardless observed status, no name lookup/adoption/replay. Known terminal receipts conclusive without I/O, including absent refs/endpoints with schema/account/revision/effect validation
